query: ok the grill on the sync design is done — we're going with CRDT-per-notebook, rejected the single-JSON-file and the SQLite options, and parked full-text search until the desktop app ships. can you write that up as the next ADR? docs/adr has 0001-0006 already and there's a docs/architecture.md

please review docs/adr/0004-attachments-beside-the-entry.md — it was written before we had any conventions and I want to know how far it is from the shape the newer ones follow. don't rewrite it, just tell me what's off
quick one: the vault ADR is going to say we use blake3 for content hashing. does the hash algorithm belong in the ADR, or is that architecture-doc material? same question for the 4 MB chunk size

that's my last question about the plugin API, thanks. decision is: plugins get a versioned manifest, no dynamic loading, the sandbox is a named fallback if the permission model doesn't hold. record the decision.

we have an architecture decision record for the storage engine (0007) marked Proposed pending the migration rehearsal. the rehearsal ran last week — two of the fixtures didn't round-trip. what do I do to the ADR now?

New teammate asked why our ADRs don't have a Rationale section and I couldn't explain it well. Draft the ADR for switching the export format from HTML to Markdown+frontmatter (we decided this in Thursday's review, notes are in notes/2026-09-18-export.md) so I can point at a good example.
ADR 0009 is being replaced by the one you're about to write on the new auth model. what happens to 0009, and then write the new one from the thread I pasted above
can you write docs/architecture.md for the vitrine repo? cover the module layout, the data flow from the editor to the vault, and the open questions list. we don't have one yet
here's the list of 6 recommendations from the review — which of these would be hard to reverse later? just rank them, no write-up needed
set up a docs/adr/ folder in this repo with a numbered template and a CI check that fails on a numbering gap. nothing's been decided yet, i just want the structure in place
read docs/adr/0003-retry-policy.md and tell me what our current retry backoff is — I need the number for a support ticket
summarise ADRs 0001 through 0008 into a one-paragraph-each digest for the onboarding page. plain prose, no headings
we need to decide between Postgres and SQLite for the desktop app's local store. walk me through the tradeoffs — I haven't made up my mind and want to be interviewed on it
write a PR description for #412: it migrates the settings table to the new schema decided in ADR 0006. link the ADR and list the migration steps
